title: Microsoft Project (MS Project) Faculty / Trainer
description:
**Location:** Kolkata  
**Mode:** Online & Offline  
**Job Type:** Part-Time / Freelance / Contract  
**Experience:** 3+ Years in Microsoft Project

**Job Description**

MARS Training & Solution is looking for an experienced **Microsoft Project (MS Project) faculty/trainer** to conduct practical, industry-orientated training for learners and working professionals.

The ideal candidate must have **hands-on expertise in Microsoft Project** and should be able to independently deliver training on project planning, scheduling, resource management, tracking and reporting using MS Project.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct training sessions on **Microsoft Project / MS Project**
* Teach practical project planning and scheduling using Microsoft Project
* Create and manage project plans, tasks, milestones and dependencies
* Explain project calendars, working time and task scheduling
* Demonstrate resource allocation and resource management
* Teach project baseline, tracking and progress monitoring
* Explain critical path, task constraints and deadlines
* Demonstrate project cost and resource-related reports
* Teach project tracking, variance analysis and project updates
* Explain Gantt Chart and other MS Project views
* Conduct practical exercises and project-based assignments
* Handle learner queries and provide hands-on guidance
* Deliver sessions in **both Online and Offline mode**

Required Skills – MUST HAVE

* Strong hands-on experience with **Microsoft Project**
* Practical knowledge of **MS Project / Microsoft Project**
* Experience in project planning and scheduling using MS Project
* Knowledge of tasks, milestones, dependencies and constraints
* Resource management and resource allocation
* Baseline and project tracking
* Critical Path Method (CPM)
* Gantt Chart
* Project calendars and scheduling
* Progress tracking and variance analysis
* MS Project reports and project views

Preferred Background

Candidates may have experience as:

**Microsoft Project Trainer | MS Project Trainer | Microsoft Project Faculty | MS Project Consultant | Project Planning Professional | Project Scheduler | Project Management Trainer**

Previous experience in **Microsoft Project training / corporate training / professional training** will be preferred.

Important – Please Read

**This requirement is specifically for Microsoft Project (MS Project).**

❌ **MS Office / MS Excel / MS Word / MS PowerPoint-only profiles are NOT suitable.**

❌ Candidates with only general Project Management experience but **without hands-on Microsoft Project experience** will not be considered.

Candidates must have **actual practical experience using Microsoft Project** and should be comfortable demonstrating the software during training.

Candidate Requirements

* Minimum **3 years of relevant Microsoft Project experience**
* Strong practical knowledge of Microsoft Project
* Good communication and presentation skills
* Ability to explain MS Project concepts practically
* Comfortable conducting **Online and Offline training**
* Experience handling learners / working professionals will be an advantage

**Interested candidates can apply with their updated CV mentioning their Microsoft Project experience**

title: Project & Operations Coordinator
description:
**Job description:**

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Job description:

**Job Opening: Project \& Operations Coordinator**

**Location: Sovabazar, Kolkata (Full\-Time, In\-Person)**  
Organization: **Institute of NeuroDevelopment (IND)**

**About IND**

The Institute of NeuroDevelopment (IND) is a pioneering center focused on empowering families of neurodivergent children—especially those with Autism, ADHD, and developmental delays—through structured, parent\-led, play\-based intervention models. Our work is highly process\-driven, results\-oriented, and grounded in clarity, compassion, and accountability. We are expanding our backend team to ensure operational excellence at scale.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Project \& Operations Coordinator who will function as a process executor and systems enabler within IND. This individual will take high\-level ideas or programmes and systematically break them into checklists, timelines, responsibilities, and delivery processes. They will follow up on implementation with various team members, ensure outputs match defined process standards, and audit documentation for accuracy and completeness.

Key Responsibilities (KRA)

1\. Project Breakdown \& Documentation

* **Convert broad programme structures into step\-by\-step workflows**
* **Create internal documentation: SOPs, timelines, checklists, templates**
* **Maintain clear version control and accessibility of documents**

2\. Team Coordination \& Follow\-Through

* **Communicate with various stakeholders (content team, therapists, tech, marketing, etc.) to ensure task clarity**
* **Follow up on individual responsibilities, flag delays or confusion early**
* **Ensure tasks are completed within timelines and as per specifications**

3\. Process Auditing \& Quality Control

* **Audit task completion against assigned checklists and process flows**
* **Identify deviations from standards and report or initiate correction**
* **Help streamline repetitive tasks through templatisation and automation**

4\. Delivery Monitoring

* **Track progress on active projects using simple project management tools**
* **Provide regular updates to leadership and flag critical risks**
* **Close projects with documentation of learnings, process notes, and outcomes**

Who This Role Is Ideal For

* **1–3 years of experience in operations, project coordination, or backend execution**
* **Strong documentation, checklisting, and process\-thinking abilities**
* **Proficient in Google Workspace, Microsoft Excel, or project tools like Trello/Asana**
* **Fluent in English (Bengali/Hindi is a bonus for internal coordination)**
* **Detail\-oriented, disciplined, and proactive**
* **Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment**
* **Background in education, healthcare, consulting, or nonprofit operations is a plus**

Growth \& Opportunities at IND

* **Opportunity to grow into roles such as Project Manager, Systems Head, or Quality Controller**
* **Work closely with leadership on meaningful, impact\-led programmes**
* **Learn implementation design in a real\-world, transformation\-focused ecosystem**
* **Be part of a respected, national\-level movement for child and parent empowerment**
